title: CoNP upper bound for minimum-weight SAT model verification
claims: MinimumWeightSATModelCheckingInCoNP gives an exact coNP upper bound for recognizing satisfying CNF models with fewest distinct true occurring names.
The polynomial-time machine counts distinct names accepted by the pinned SAT witness encoding and compares the resulting unary counts.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
